violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds of the slice (otherwise undefined behavior).
violations.explanation: `self.qv.data.get_unchecked(line_id + j)` is called with no bounds check. `line_id` comes from `pos`, and `j` can be 1 for 512-bit blocks, so `line_id + j` can be past the end of `data`. This is reachable from the safe `SelectQuad::select`.

violations.requirement: The CPU must support the `popcnt` target feature. The caller has to check this at runtime or enable it at compile time.
violations.explanation: `_popcnt64` is called under `cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")` only. Nothing checks that `popcnt` is available, either with `is_x86_feature_detected!` or with `target_feature`. On a CPU without it this is undefined behavior. It is reachable from the safe `select1` and `select0`.
